value.description: Synthesizere, DJ-utstyr, eurorack og vinyl fra Norges fremste uavhengige musikkbutikk. Besøk oss i Oslo sentrum eller handle trygt på nett.
value.main_text_excerpt:
Filter Musikk er en spesialistbutikk for synthesizere, DJ-utstyr, eurorack moduler og elektroniske instrumenter - med over 20 års erfaring som Norges fremste uavhengige musikkbutikk.
Vi fører alt fra Pioneer DJ (DDJ-FLX4, XDJ-RX3, XDJ-RR) og AlphaTheta (CDJ-1500X, XDJ-AN), Technics, Moog-synthesizere, Intellijel eurorack-moduler, vinylplater. Besøk oss i Oslo sentrum eller handle enkelt online.

pages.title: Musikkbutikk i Oslo – DJ-utstyr, synth & vinyl | Filter Musikk
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Filter Musikk er en spesialistbutikk for synthesizere, DJ-utstyr, eurorack moduler og elektroniske instrumenter - med over 20 års erfaring som Norges fremste uavhengige musikkbutikk.
Vi fører alt fra Pioneer DJ (DDJ-FLX4, XDJ-RX3, XDJ-RR) og AlphaTheta (CDJ-1500X, XDJ-AN), Technics, Moog-synthesizere, Intellijel eurorack-moduler, vinylplater. Besøk oss i Oslo sentrum eller handle enkelt online.

pages.title: Om oss | Filter Musikk → Filter Musikk
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Filter Musikk AS har over 20 års erfaring som Norges fremste uavhengige butikk for
elektronisk musikkutstyr og vinyl, med spesialisering på det siste innen elektronisk
instrumenter og klubbmusikk.
Vi tilbyr også et omfattende utvalg av vinyl fra både velkjente og mindre kjente lokale og
europeiske leverandører, samt de ferskeste utgivelsene fra klubb- og undergrunnsscenen.
Vårt team, med solid erfaring i musikkproduksjon og DJ-ing, er klare til å veilede deg
gjennom alt fra valg av ditt første DJ-utstyr til å finne den perfekte syntheziseren for
ditt neste prosjekt.
Vårt produktutvalg strekker seg fra nybegynnernivå til profesjonelt utstyr. Besøk oss i
butikken som ligger midt i Oslo sentrum.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
Filter Musikk is simply the best music store in Oslo & Norway for anyone serious about electronic music. Whether you’re a DJ, producer, performer, or just starting your journey into synthesis and sound design — this is your place.

What sets Filter apart is the combination of an outstanding product selection and genuinely knowledgeable staff. They consistently stock the latest in synthesizers, drum machines, controllers, effects, and studio gear, and they always seem to be ahead of the curve when it comes to what’s relevant in the scene right now. You won’t find yourself staring at an empty shelf or being told something is “on order” — they stay on top of their inventory in a way that’s rare for a specialist store.

But the real difference is the people. The team here actually plays, produces, and uses the equipment they sell. That means you get real, honest advice rather than a sales pitch. They take the time to understand what you’re trying to achieve and point you in the right direction — whether you’re investing in your first synth or upgrading a professional live setup.

For anyone working in electronic music in Norway or Europe for that matter, Filter musikk isn’t just a stor

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Best record shop in Norway for electronic music! Staff is super knowledgeable. All kinds of other genres as well, plenty of second hand. You can check their stock on discogs, but some titles you can only find in the store.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: highly recommend this music store! The staff was extremely polite and helpful. When I was unsure about my purchase, the salesperson took the time to explain everything I needed to know without trying to push unnecessary products on me. Instead, he approached everything from a practical perspective, which I really appreciated. The visit was very pleasant, and I received a lot of valuable advice. A great experience overall!

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Warning to anyone wanting to buy here: they do not accept returns! Do not buy anything here. He kinda forced our hand to buy a part we didn’t need and when we went back to return it he refused saying it was his shops policy. Who does that? He said ‘it’s Norwegian law that I don’t have to accept refunds’. It’s also legal to cheat on your wife but it doesn’t make it moral. Never ever had another shop in Oslo do this. AVOID!!

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Best record store in the Nordics. The folks who run it are friendly, knowledge and have great taste in music and gear. I am very happy with the beats I've bought classic and new, the vinyls are in excellent condition.
